title: Opus 5.5 impressed me most
author: RumeroBusiolp
selftext:
Try it out here   
https://bunnings-trolley-game.vercel.app

Made this trolley game literally from a prompt. Opus 5.5 (set on extra) built the whole thing from assets, mechanics. Asked it to use Three JS and isometric/cartoony/low poly art style. Ai game dev is getting crazy

replies.author: RumeroBusiolp
replies.body: No just it’s just web app, so can be played on any browser desktop or mobile.

comments.author: TheDannos
comments.body:
Here is small feedback from my side
- funny game, ended at shift 8 or something like that
- pretty quickly I maxed everything and have a few thousand of coins nothing to do with it
- I was having a lot of issues with pushing an 11 of trolleys, I was getting stuck most of a time and sometimes was not able to move at all.
- in-store bay of 20 trolleys was limiting at every game, it was quickly full and the end of the game I was standing there with 11 trolleys and not doing anything and waiting for time be over
But overall funny game, but right now only for a few minutes:)

replies.author: RumeroBusiolp
replies.body:
Hey really appreciate the feedback! Really good insights and some of the points you mentioned I’ve noticed it as well.

Definitely will consider the above and try to improve! I’m trying to make it so you can get upgrades as well like trolley machine that u can push around to collect. And upgrade to fit more trolley in the bays.

Also motivated sometimes ur stuck while moving the trolleys around. Thanks a lot for playing and for the feedback :)

replies.author: Sylvonara
replies.body: I agree, it should be a bit more challenging, maybe reduce the amount earned per turn so buffs feel more rewarding
